messages:
Maya (CSM): Heads-up — final prep for the Carvana QBR tomorrow 10:00am PT. Need slide ownership, demo readiness, and the top 3 exec asks finalized. I want a 30m runthrough today 4:00pm PT. Please confirm availability and upload slides to the deck link.
Ravi (AM): I can cover renewal health + usage trends. Adding one ask: confirm the billing delta explanation slide. Link to current deck: https://drive.google.com/acme-qbr-draft (v3).
Eli (Eng): I'll take the infra/latency improvements slide and can demo the new batching config if infra is green. Need a short script for the demo (what success looks like).
Grace (Enablement): I'll own enablement/rollout playbook slide + enablement ask. Will add the 3 suggested playbook steps and a snippet of customer-facing training plan.
Jonah (Acct Exec): Re: exec asks — prioritize: 1) multi-region SLA, 2) predictable spend reduction, 3) timeline for Private deployment. I'll draft language for each.
Maya (CSM): Great. Action items: - Ravi: billing delta + slide (due today 2pm) - Eli: demo script + demo checklist (due today 3pm) - Grace: playbook + enablement ask (due today 2pm) - Jonah: exec ask bullet points (due today 2pm). Please add checkboxes in the deck.
Ravi (AM): Quick Q — For billing delta, do we want per-token breakdown or just month-over-month delta and top drivers?
Maya (CSM): Per-token breakdown + top 2 drivers. One slide, keep it high level.
Eli (Eng): Deploy infra change to staging now, will smoke test and post logs here. If green, demo should be a 2-minute warmup + 3 minute run.
qbr-bot: Reminder: "QBR runthrough" scheduled at 16:00 PT today. Join link: https://zoom.us/meet/12345
Grace (Enablement): Added training timeline snippet to the deck (slide 8). Left a note with TODOs for the enablement checklist.
Maya (CSM): Also: capture feedback loop mechanism — add a slide that shows prompt sets + eval metric used to detect regressions. Keep it one visual.
Eli (Eng): Pasted demo checklist: 
```
- start staging cluster with demo config
- run 3 sample prompts (welcome flow, billing query, search assist)
- verify latency < 250ms p50, p95 < 800ms
- validate outputs for hallucination regression
```
Will paste logs after tests.
Ravi (AM): Uploaded billing slide (slide 4) and added notes for speaking points.
Jonah (Acct Exec): I'm on for the 4pm runthrough. If execs ask about Private timeline, be ready with the 3-phase plan and required approvals.
Maya (CSM): Perfect. One more ask: capture any renewal risk flags in the companion spreadsheet (column: risk_level, mitigation). I'll export that to the deck appendix.
Grace (Enablement): Captured enablement metrics and added 'customer training adoption' as a renewal health signal.
Eli (Eng): Staging smoke tests: all green. Latency p50 180ms, p95 430ms. Logs: https://logs.internal/reports/1728504321/summary
Maya (CSM): Thanks — updated the runbook and added demo link. If no further blockers, we'll run at 4pm. See you then. :thumbsup:
Ravi (AM): Confirmed.
Jonah (Acct Exec): Confirmed.
Grace (Enablement): Confirmed.
qbr-bot: Event updated: "QBR runthrough" — attendees: Maya, Ravi, Eli, Grace, Jonah.
